{{Top|leg}}
The "'''time-stream'''" is a term used to describe the concept that time is a constant forward flow, and that flow can be perceived. Several beings in the galaxy, such as the [[H'Drachi Seers|Seers]] of the [[H'drachi]], reported the ability to view the time-stream using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. They claim they were therefore able to avoid or change the future they had seen, creating divergences in the time-stream.
